name: s81lk_kp4_deca-k4-COMMIT

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_kp4_dec_a u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -Irtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_common.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_bm.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_dec_a.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_deca/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_deca/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_deca --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_kp4_dec_a --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w2c_64x546_m1 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-KP4 10-17: FRONT hard sub-tile of the KP4 decoder cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec (the one-tile streaming decoder s81lk_kp4_dec measured at its CTS gate 11,098 sinks in 367.2 x 345.6 um: TT insertion 383-513 ps, spread 130 ps, setup -121 ps (align popcount -> FSM -> 32-bit counter from the pin) -- split into two ~260 um tiles with their own roots, registered seam). Alignment FSM on registered am_ok / p_v; syndromes on the arriving stream (fixed-offset one-hot select x4 copies, window matrix registered a cycle ahead); 3 RiBM key-equation units (one GF multiply + XOR a cycle, PE-group control copies); 64 x 546 received-word SRAM delay line u_dmem on the 43.2 lattice (pins on its W / E edges; std cells in one band around it). West face = PMA side (p_d full face); east face = the seam to s81lk_kp4_decb (d_q 544 + k_* 320, pin positions identical to decb's west face); clk / rst_n S centre. Regional synchronous reset, no datapath reset. Exact vs rs544.py through the cluster (KP4 bench base PASS 140 out / 122 exact / 17 flagged / 0 miscorrected; front mutant MUT 3 FAIL).
